desc: The RAPIDE (Frost) (DN,NS). A truly unique 1911 with stepped cocking serrations, slide lightening cuts for faster Slide lock-up and DLC coated barrel for extreme durability. Equipped with Kimber Stiplex TM front strap stippling and Black G10 Rapide patterned grips for extra griping confidence. Kimpro Silver finish with brush polished flats finish off the stunning looks.
